title: Enterprise assurance priority sieve and evidence router
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Design and deliver a lightweight, automatable 'priority sieve' that classifies incoming enterprise security and compliance requests (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires) and routes them with a pre-bundled evidence packet to the right internal lane (security engineering, legal, customer success, or partner ops).

Problem statement: Enterprise customers submit heterogeneous requests: full questionnaires, one-off contract clauses, region-specific data residency asks, and audit evidence pulls. Current intake is manual, slow, and inconsistent in priority assignment which causes SLA misses and wasted reviewer time. We need a deterministic, auditable triage model that reduces mean time to first response and accelerates fulfillment of common evidence asks.

Scope: This ticket covers the triage model, evidence router rules, UI intake form changes, webhook-based automation for high-frequency asks, and an initial set of canned evidence bundles. Implementation will include schema for intake metadata, scoring rules, routing destinations, and visibility hooks in the Console. Integration points: Security team Confluence playbook (link in links), legal evidence catalog, customer success intake queue, and GitHub PR for automation lambda.

Non-goals: Full natural language QA of questionnaires (future), replacing human review for nuanced legal negotiations, or storing PII in the public Console UI.

Success metrics: 50% reduction in manual routing work within 8 weeks, 30% faster mean time to first meaningful response for P1 enterprise requests, and >90% correct initial routing in a 500-sample audit.
acceptance_criteria: Automated scoring output for incoming requests with at least 6 rule-based signals (e.g., request type, customer size, contract stage, data residency, certification ask, SLA target).
Routing rules produce a single destination lane (security/ legal/ cs/ infra) and a confidence score; human reviewer can override and provide a reason recorded in the ticket history.
Evidence router attaches a minimal evidence bundle for common asks (SOC2 summary, ISO cert digest, DPA template, HIPAA scoping checklist) as a downloadable package.

Webhook integration sends high-confidence routing decisions to the target team's queue (Slack + internal ticketing) and creates a linked Linear sub-issue when 'manual fulfillment required' is flagged.
Console intake form updated with normalized metadata fields (region, data types, retention, controller/processor relationship, contract stage) and telemetry captured for analytics.
Audit log captures triage decision, scorer version, and user override for compliance and post-mortem reviews.
Initial rollout to a pilot group of three enterprise customers and validation of routing accuracy on 500 historical asks.
Documentation and runbook published in Confluence and linked from the Console intake flow.
